guidance.title: Read and plan
guidance.text: Identify what is known and what the final answer must describe.

guidance.title: Choose operations
guidance.text: Decide which quantities to combine. Write each intermediate result with its units.

guidance.title: Check and answer
guidance.text: Check with an inverse or estimate, then answer the original question.
